description: OMENZ Doc Read: turn a public PDF (or .txt/.md/.html) into clean text your agent can use. Send {url} (https) or {content_base64, filename}. Priced per document, no account: first 50 pages, text per page, title/author/dates, language guess, word count, links, tables hint. Native text only, no OCR: scanned/image-only PDFs come back flagged needs_ocr. Max 10 MB, 200k chars. Deterministic, stores nothing. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/doc/read, $0.004 via x402.)

content_base64.description: the document bytes, base64 (instead of url)

url.description: public https URL of a PDF or text/markdown/html document
